title: Raworth doughnut overshoot and shortfall
summary: GDP growth optimises one metric without coordinating with ecology or wellbeing: it pushes the economy through the ecological ceiling while the social floor stays unmet. Regenerative, distributive economics is the missing coordination layer that would land the economy inside the doughnut.
source: Ch09 §9.2 — Raworth interview; "growth occurs without flourishing."
